claims.claim: The model states rather than earns: a later claim is not set up by the sentences before it, so weight is asserted, not built.
claims.source: sudo, LessWrong close reading of a Claude passage (2026-04-12)
claims.quote: Claude does not use its preceding sentences to justify the claim

claims.claim: AI fiction has no grain: no proper nouns, specific months, brand names, or regional dialect markers.
claims.quote: No grain: no proper nouns, no specific months, no brand names.
claims.page: I Asked the Machine to Tell on Itself: A Field Guide to AI Tells

claims.claim: AI cannot build meaning by accumulating repeated specific observations across a manuscript, and it describes emotions rather than showing them through behavior.
claims.source: Richard Lowe, ghostwriter, Association of Ghostwriters (2026-04-29)
claims.page: The Real Reason Not to Use AI to Write Your Novel

claims.claim: AI prose stays in shallow point of view, avoids concrete sensory detail, and delivers emotions disconnected from the trigger that should have produced them.
claims.quote: It will fail to have the emotion linked to it
claims.page: What Makes a Story "Look" Like AI Wrote It?

claims.claim: Every choice the prompter does not make, the model fills with the statistical average, and that average is the least interesting choice available.
claims.quote: that average is equivalent to the least interesting choices possible
claims.page: Human Editors vs AI Editing: What AI Still Can't Do

claims.claim: Fiction is roughly one deliberate choice per word; a prompt makes far fewer choices, and the unmade choices come out generic and without intention.
claims.quote: Art is something that results from making a lot of choices.

claims.claim: Five different LLMs' stories occupy one overlapping region of narrative-feature space, while human stories span more locations, more dialogue, and a broader repertoire; named intertextual references appear in 24% of AI stories versus 47% of human.
claims.quote: AI-generated stories cluster in a shared region of narrative space
claims.page: StoryScope: Investigating idiosyncrasies in AI fiction

claims.claim: Generated game dialogue is competent and forgettable, makes a whole cast sound like one person, and misses the specific surprising line that makes a moment land (vendor source with a stake).
claims.quote: weak at the specific, surprising sentence that makes a moment land
claims.page: AI Dialogue Generator for Games: What Actually Works in 2026

claims.claim: AI prose has low sentence-length variation, producing rhythmic uniformity; scenes also unfold at a constant rate with no selective summary or elision.
claims.quote: Scenes unfold at a constant rate
claims.page: I Asked the Machine to Tell on Itself: A Field Guide to AI Tells

claims.claim: Generated text has a predictable, even rhythm and no emotional valence, so it lulls rather than moves the reader.
claims.quote: could lull the reader to sleep
claims.page: How editors should handle AI-generated manuscripts

claims.claim: AI fiction reuses identical sentence shapes over and over, which even a beginning human writer would not do.
claims.quote: A new writer wouldn't repeat sentence shapes again and again
claims.page: How to Identify AI-Written Web Fiction

claims.claim: AI prose alternates mechanically between long comparisons and short stock phrases, and once it reaches a cliché it keeps drawing from the same well where a human would rest it.
claims.quote: Writing keeps swinging between long comparisons, then short stock phrases
claims.page: How to Identify AI-Written Web Fiction

claims.claim: AI plants one-sentence fragment paragraphs before scene hooks and an em-dash per paragraph, and the pattern has become recognizable to editors.
claims.quote: The rhythm is becoming recognizable as an AI pattern
claims.page: What Makes a Story "Look" Like AI Wrote It?

claims.claim: Short punchy standalone fragments are used for manufactured emphasis that does not match human speech or prose patterns.
claims.quote: He published this. Openly. In a book.

claims.claim: Vendor measurement: about 85% of GPT-4o sentences fall in the 15-28 word range and Gemini paragraphs are nearly identical in length, versus human prose ranging 4 to 55+ words with no central cluster (unreplicated vendor figures).
claims.quote: AI rhythm is the mechanical, metronomic quality of text
